json.justification: Left of the gas meter (Photos 1, 2, 5), the same side wall runs as a long, open stretch of ivy-covered, roughly level ground toward the AC unit (Photos 6-9) and back fence. You can place the battery here about 3+ ft past the gas meter, with a wide-open front and full headroom under a high eave. The harness runs along this one continuous wall from the nearby electric meter, past the gas meter, with no door or garage in between.
